The Big Beautiful Bill's approach to Medicaid and SNAP is exactly why structural reform matters. While safety nets are vital, the real issue is where the money flows. This bill fails to target the $200B/year in Medicaid fraud from pharmaceutical overpayments and billing scams, or the $50B in SNAP errors from bureaucratic mismanagement.

Instead of trimming fat like bloated hospital admin costs or Medicare Advantage scams, it pressures states with unfunded mandates. Washington’s projected $360M annual loss in grocery revenue proves the cuts hurt local economies.

True reform would audit pharma kickbacks, end 30% upcharges on generics, and redirect those savings to patients—not slash benefits while leaving corporate welfare untouched.
